//: The build tooling and the check scripts, which tsconfig.json's include leaves out. They were unchecked code: an invalid config object in check-token-snapshot.ts (typographyScale: 1.333, when the field is a string union) compiled without complaint and produced a snapshot that silently exercised nothing. Separate from tsconfig.json because these run in Node and need its globals, while src/ runs in the Figma sandbox and deliberately restricts `types` to the plugin typings so a stray `process.env` in plugin code is an error.
